capabilities: Browse notes by keyword and folder entries in a sidebar
Expand multi-level sub-tag trees such as test/work/meeting
Aggregate notes matching any tag in a configured group
Filter matching notes by week, month, quarter, or custom date range
Edit all matching notes in one scrollable view with arrow-key navigation
disambiguation: Not a tag or keyword editor; it displays and edits whole notes grouped under configured tags and folders in one view.
extras: Accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee and WeChat; installation can also be done manually from GitHub Releases. Carries the standard notice that it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: View and edit notes grouped by keyword tags, similar to Logseq tag view.
problem: Obsidian's tag search surfaces matching notes one at a time, so reviewing or editing many tagged notes means opening each in a separate tab.
